implementation_status: implemented in staging; canonical promotion not performed

observed_contract.entry_count: Uses the signed/unsigned 0x18-stride count derived from receiver +0x18 minus +0x14 and scans entries in ascending order.
observed_contract.empty_name: An entry is skipped when its +0x08 and +0x0c name pointers are equal.
observed_contract.comparison: Non-empty names are compared with the imported _stricmp against the stack name.
observed_contract.activation: On the first case-insensitive match, the registry vtable slot +0x40 is called with the zero-based entry index; its boolean result is returned.
observed_contract.not_found: Returns zero without activation dispatch when no non-empty name matches.

live_provenance.decompile: Live pseudocode scans entry name ranges, skips empty ranges, calls _stricmp, and dispatches the matched index through receiver vtable +0x40.
live_provenance.disassembly: Live instructions establish the 0x18 stride, compare +0x08 and +0x0c, call the imported case-insensitive compare, and push the matched index before the vtable call.

runtime_gate: Observe entry name storage, registry vtable target, and runtime case-insensitive matching; runtime validation is not run.
listener_timing: No synchronous listener timing is claimed; the registry activation call is represented only as the observed vtable dispatch.
